findings.title: send() gate verified to cover all callers, including compressor send_empty_frame hooks
findings.claim: The report states every caller of send() is accounted for: the sink path is guarded by sink_closed(), the eof marker is sent before close_sink() runs, client/server requests use non-stream connections where stream_close() never runs, and the compressor send_empty_frame hooks (rpc.cc:696, rpc.cc:1103) were the only unguarded callers, now closed by the new flag.

findings.title: Queue drain via swapping _outgoing_queue_ready is safe and preserves…
findings.claim: The report states that swapping _outgoing_queue_ready for a ready future is safe because no new entries can be enqueued afterward, the withdraw() chain invariant holds, and stop_send_loop() still awaits the whole queue transitively through _sink_closed_future.

findings.title: Race between stop_send_loop() and stream_close() produces the same outcome as before the…
findings.claim: The report states that whichever of stop_send_loop() or stream_close() runs first, the outcome (skip via error(), or exceptional drained future being ignored while the buffer still closes) is unchanged from pre-change behavior, so no new race is introduced.

findings.title: Documentation matches code: ~sink_impl assertion and source's lack of close()
findings.claim: The report states the docs match the code: ~sink_impl asserts on an unclosed sink, and source has no close() method.

findings.title: const_cast on this used to push hooks in hook_capturing_compressor_factory::negotiate
findings.claim: In hook_capturing_compressor_factory::negotiate, a const_cast on this is used to push hooks; a mutable member would express the same intent without the cast.

findings.title: test_stream_send_after_stream_close relies on sequencing rather than ownership for…
findings.claim: The wrapped data sink in test_stream_send_after_stream_close holds a reference to the stack-local test_sink_state; it is safe only because close is released and awaited before scope exit, meaning the lifetime guarantee comes from sequencing rather than ownership.

findings.title: PR body includes a "Generated with Claude Code" attribution line
findings.claim: The report notes as an aside that the PR body ends with a "Generated with Claude Code" line, which the user's global instructions say to never include.
